Porque había un sueño que era más grande que todo: ganar algo con la Selección. Y un día rompiste esa pared. Nos enseñaste que rendirse nunca es una opción, que los sueños se persiguen hasta el final y que el esfuerzo siempre encuentra su recompensa. Jamás nos dejaste solos. Jamás abandonaste este escudo. Y por eso te voy a admirar toda la vida. No llores, capitán. El fútbol ya te hizo eterno. Ya no le debés absolutamente nada a este deporte. Fuiste el pibe que soñó y terminó inspirando a millones de argentinos. Y si las despedidas siempre duelen, esta duele un poco más. Porque no solo termina un Mundial; también se cierra una de las etapas más lindas de nuestra historia. Gracias por cada alegría, por cada abrazo, por cada lágrima y por hacernos creer cuando parecía imposible. Gracias por todo, Leo. #messi #10 #retirement #argentina #fyp 🇦🇷 Messi — 2022 World Cup Final On December 18, 2022, Argentina faced France in the World Cup final in Qatar. Messi scored a penalty in the first half, and Ángel Di María made it 2–0 before halftime. France came back through Kylian Mbappé, who scored twice to make it 2–2.  In extra time, Messi scored again to put Argentina ahead 3–2, but Mbappé completed his hat-trick with another penalty, making it 3–3. Argentina eventually won the penalty shootout 4–2, with Emiliano Martínez making key saves and Gonzalo Montiel scoring the winning penalty.  The victory gave Messi the World Cup trophy that had been missing from his career, and he was named the tournament’s Golden Ball winner. 🐐 Messi’s Argentina retirement — 2026 Messi continued playing for Argentina after the 2022 triumph, including winning another Copa América in 2024 and playing at the 2026 World Cup. After Argentina’s 2026 World Cup final defeat to Spain, Messi announced on August 31, 2026 that he was retiring from international football. He said he felt he had given everything to the national team and that it was time for the next generation.  On October 6, 2026, Messi played his final match for Argentina against Benin at the Monumental Stadium in Buenos Aires, officially closing a 21-year international career. He finished with 207+ appearances and 125+ goals for Argentina.  In short: 2022: Messi finally conquered the World Cup with Argentina. 🏆 2026: After more than two decades representing Argentina, he said goodbye to the national team. 🇦🇷
